docs.title: A Personal Atlas
docs.text:
Image source: Kaiju No. 8 — Official Website

Places, Journeys & Experiences.

I've spent time living, studying, working, and travelling across different parts of the world. Taiwan, California, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Singapore have been recurring bases, with shorter journeys and detours in between.

This site collects those experiences beyond an itinerary: places explored by rail and on foot, food encountered along the way, sporting activities, live performances, and events worth remembering. Some trips were planned around a particular occasion; others were simply opportunities to see somewhere new.

  • Travels: Country and city journals, regional journeys, photographs, and an interactive global mobility map.
  • Activities & Experiences: Running, skiing, outdoor excursions, food discoveries, concerts, motorsport, and football.
  • Personal Archive: A growing collection of images, videos, event notes, and reflections, organised by place and occasion.

docs.title: 👀About
docs.text:
I'm Alvin.

Originally from Taiwan, I've spent much of my life moving between Asia, Europe and North America — studying, working, travelling and finding reasons to explore somewhere new.

I've never been particularly interested in following a fixed itinerary, whether in travel or in life. Sometimes that means crossing borders by train, spending an afternoon somewhere unfamiliar, or making a detour simply because something caught my attention. Other times, it's attending a major sporting event, getting out on the water, or discovering a place worth returning to.

I enjoy the contrast between big cities and quieter corners, familiar routines and unexpected experiences. Railways, aviation, sport, music, food and the everyday character of different places have all given me plenty of reasons to keep exploring.

This site is a personal atlas of those experiences — not a checklist of destinations, but a collection of places, moments and journeys I've found worth remembering.
